_about: Input for the 'My own portfolio' section. Percentages only: no dollar amounts, account numbers, institution names or employer details belong in this file. Change the numbers here and re-run scripts/model/build.mjs; the page follows.
_holdings: weight is percent of the liquid portfolio (View A). 'look' is the look-through to the model's asset classes per 1.00 of the holding; a leveraged fund has exposure above 1 and negative cash. 'tilt' marks holdings that are not a broad index.

holdings.label: U.S. total stock market index fund
International stocks ex U.S., index ETF
2x daily leveraged ETF on one stock
Listed closed-end fund of private companies

viewB._note: Unvested employer stock as a share of the total when it is included. 'About 35%'. No company name, ticker, price or grant detail belongs here.

plan._contribPerQuarterPct: New money added each quarter, as a percent of today's liquid portfolio. Not known yet: leave null. The page then shows the path without it and a what-if table.
plan._bankCashIsReserve: true: bank cash stays outside the model as a reserve. false: it is invested with the rest.
